title: Picatrix complete lunar-mansion operation-and-argument bundles
summary: RAW_SOURCE_SUPPORTED, NOT SELECTED. Picatrix I.iv contains a complete28-member register of repeated intended effects and arguments. This is a relational source distinct from a mansion-name spelling roster, but a historically justified complete short-label compiler and source-only semantic collation are missing. No target fit, no repair of F69M001 orGDT898.

design.source: David Pingree(ed.), Picatrix: The Latin Version of the Ghayat al-Hakim, WarburgInstitute1986, I.iv paragraphs2–29, printedpp9–14, PDFpages91–96. Official completePDF https://commons.warburg.sas.ac.uk/downloads/8g84mm241?locale=en ; SHA25682cdf4da0b5490d06e25a5a042c7444dce83b1d8259cb89d27559b74c0edc011. Full28 passage read as extractedLatin; native printedpp9,14 checked. The prologue reports completion of Arabic-to-Spanish translation in1256; this does not date the Latin witness exactly. Modern critical edition and manuscript variants must remain explicit.
design.source_example: Mansion1 supports protection/return of travellers but also producing discord between spouses, friends or partners. Mansion3 includes protecting sea travellers, strengthening a prison, completing alchemical/fire works, hunting, and marital affection. These are intended effects of images, not merely a table of activities recommended or forbidden on that day. Common good/bad-operation lunar conditions appear atI.iv2 and31; omission or a separate context role must be declared.
design.mechanism: Proposed conditional whole-register law: source-only collation gives each of28rows its complete sequence or multiset of typed clauses (effect operator, argument roles, direction/polarity, qualifications). A single finite globally reused primitive code and a fixed composition grammar must encode every complete target inscription as the entire corresponding source bundle under one cyclic rotation/reflection. No row-specific action choice, learned whole-row macro, omitted effect or changed synonym classes. The spelling channel and serialization are not yet selected; this is not a decoder specification.
design.independence: F69M001 compared prefixes of unique Agrippa mansion names under56alignments and failed its declared deeper-topology/null/margin gates. Repeated typed effects would be different constraints only if independently collated and observably composed. Repeating the name roster, or replacing names by arbitrary bundle identifiers, adds no relational evidence. Known GDT898 whole-entry collisions remain binding for any deterministic complete-bundle decoder whenever the corresponding complete source bundles differ.
design.identifiability: For a global decoder D and source bundlesA_m, require D(t_i)=A_(r+epsilon*i mod28), epsilon in{-1,+1}, over all28complete entries. Same t implies sameA independent of alignment. A label primitive can name an operator or argument only if the fixed grammar makes those fields observable and all solutions agree. If every whole label is merely assigned an opaque row ID, simultaneous permutations preserve the supposed semantics. If each row may select any one allowed effect, a recurrent common effect can absorb many labels and the complete register is no longer tested.
design.source_debt: No fixed authorial matrix, abbreviated operation alphabet, or canonical short-code serialization has been established. Latin wording varies among synonymous-looking clauses; collapsing strengthen-prison, imprison, harm-captive and prolong-captivity would be interpretation, not literalidentity. Negative intended effects must not be converted to prohibitions. A complete source-only clause/argument collation and duplicate-bundle partition are prerequisite to assessing whether the known target collisions already end this route.
design.decision: NO_GO for implementation now. Retain source availability. Do not acquire replacement corpora, choose favourable subsets, reclassify target entries, or loosen channel after a contradiction. A future bounded source-collation decision must show a new identifiable prediction beyond unique-row equality before decoder work. No Voynich query or new Voynich image was opened in this source review; earlier target exposure persists and this observer is not target-blind.
